rules_text:
# gkeep — local post-it. No floating-window tag: Omarchy sizes that tag at 875×600.
windowrule = float on, match:class ^(org.omarchy.gkeep)$
windowrule = center on, match:class ^(org.omarchy.gkeep)$
windowrule = size 420 500, match:class ^(org.omarchy.gkeep)$
